document.abstract: This survey of the more important technical progress made by the motion picture industry during 1947 is classified as follows: A—Introduction, B—Cinematography, C—Sound Recording, D—Picture and Sound Reproduction, E—Television, and F—Standards. Developments relating to 35-, 16-, and 8-mm films are discussed under the major headings.
